title: LoopFill: Pipelined Multi-Token Speculative Decoding for Looped Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2611.19649v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. During autoregressive decoding, however, generating each token requires several sequential passes through these layers, leading to high decoding latency. Pipelined self-speculative methods use shallow-loop predictions to process tokens at different loops in the same batch, but each token must reach the drafting depth before the next can enter the pipeline. We introduce LoopFill, a training-free speculative decoding algorithm for looped LLM that combines multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions in a single draft tree. Both drafters contribute to one tree, so a suffix lookup can immediately extend a shallow prediction and several future tokens can enter the pipeline together. The shared block computes the highest-scoring draft candidates at different loop depths in one batch, and full-depth verification preserves the model'

translated_title: LoopFill：面向循环Transformer的流水线式多Token推测解码
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer通过重复应用相同的Transformer层来提高参数效率。然而，在自回归解码过程中，生成每个Token都需要多次顺序通过这些层，导致解码延迟较高。流水线自推测方法使用浅层循环预测在同一批次中处理处于不同循环阶段的Token，但每个Token必须先达到草稿深度，下一个Token才能进入流水线。我们提出了LoopFill，这是一种无需训练的循环大语言模型推测解码算法，它将多Token后缀草稿与浅层循环预测结合在一个草稿树中。两种草稿生成器共同贡献于同一棵树，因此后缀查找可以立即扩展浅层预测，多个未来Token可以同时进入流水线。共享块在一个批次中于不同循环深度计算得分最高的草稿候选，而全深度验证则保持了模型的输出质量。
tldr: LoopFill是一种无需训练的推测解码算法，通过将多Token后缀草稿与浅层循环预测融合到同一草稿树中，实现多个Token同时进入流水线并行处理，显著降低循环Transformer的解码延迟。
en_tdlr: LoopFill is a training-free speculative decoding algorithm that merges multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions into a single draft tree, allowing multiple future tokens to enter the pipeline simultaneously and significantly reducing decoding latency for looped transformers.
